rms_norm: strict increasing-index f32 square/add, f32 divide, f32 sqrt, f32 reciprocal, f32 multiply by input then weight
matvec: strict increasing-column f32 multiply then f32 add for every row
attention_score: strict increasing latent columns then rope columns, scale f32 by 1/16
softmax: single visible element has exact f32 weight 1
attention_residual: one f32 addition in ascending element order
router: strict sequential f32 matvec followed by selection contract
